record_notice: This collection contains seventeen sourced recipes, eight original practical notes for a small air fryer, and three fixtures. The sourced recipes summarize cooking facts from the pages they cite. The practical notes were written for this project without outside sources; their cooking guidance has not been independently verified. The fixtures are demonstration records for testing the site, not researched recipes. Each record identifies its type. Nothing in the collection has been kitchen-tested here or given a professional food-safety review.
description: The Library's first themed collection brings together recipes with notes on regional variations, sources, revisions and rights.
scope_note: Contains twenty-eight records: seventeen sourced recipes, eight original practical notes and three fixtures. The sourced recipes include thirteen beginner oven recipes and four small-batch beginner desserts. They cite recipe pages for quantities, temperatures and timings, and identify food-safety authorities for safety thresholds. Source limitations and pending checks are noted in the individual records. These recipes have not been kitchen-tested here and are not publication-ready. The Quick Air-Fryer practical notes were written for this project without outside sources and have not been independently verified. Follow the appliance manual and product instructions; where a note refers to local food-safety guidance, confirm the applicable requirements before cooking, transport or holding. The fixtures are demonstration records used to test the site's pages, search and region filter. No record includes an image, an authenticity claim or a cooking-test result.

sections.title: Quick Air-Fryer
sections.intro: Eight original practical notes for a small air fryer using ordinary supermarket ingredients, five of them vegetarian. Each gives a starting temperature in Celsius, a cooking time and checks to make as you cook. The garlic and lemon salmon note also covers transport and holding for a shared table, with requirements to confirm under local food-safety guidance rather than a fixed time on the table. These notes have no outside sources, have not been kitchen-tested here and have had no professional food-safety review.

change_history.change: Added the collection's first four desserts, all sourced, beginner-level and scaled down for two or three: no-cook yoghurt, berry and granola cups, an egg-free chocolate microwave mug cake, a half-size apple crumble, and a lemon posset without its shortbread. Each cites its recipe page, accessed 2026-10-10, and says plainly which amounts are the source's and which are this project's scaling, metric conversion, equipment and storage advice. None has been kitchen-tested here. They are placed after the lamb oven batch and before the Quick Air-Fryer notes; every existing record, the section, and the fixtures are unchanged.

Added three further sourced oven recipes, all lamb and all built on Australian supermarket cuts — a cumin and paprika lamb rack roast for one or two, a rosemary-garlic lamb leg mini roast, and a slow-roast lamb shoulder — placed after the second oven batch and before the Quick Air-Fryer notes. Each cites its recipe page, plus the guides behind every temperature it states: Health Canada and Food Standards Australia New Zealand for safety and leftovers, and Australian Lamb's doneness guide, labelled as an eating-quality guide, for the two cuts that may be served pink. All were accessed 2026-10-06. The two earlier lamb records, every other record, the section, and the fixtures are unchanged.

Added four further sourced beginner oven recipes — a Portuguese-style chicken and potato bake, a puttanesca fish traybake, a roasted vegetable gnocchi bake, and a baked ziti — placed after the six earlier oven records and before the Quick Air-Fryer notes. Each cites its recipe page, plus Health Canada for every temperature threshold it states; all four were accessed 2026-10-06. Every existing record, the section, and the fixtures are unchanged.

Added an eighth original practical note to the Quick Air-Fryer section: garlic and lemon salmon for a shared table, placed at the end of the section and the air-fryer list. It originally included a cook-to temperature, a transport rule and a cumulative holding clock. Those fixed thresholds were removed in a later revision; the current note asks readers to confirm cooking, transport and holding requirements with their local food-safety authority. The existing salmon note and all other records were unchanged in this release.

Shortened the Quick Air-Fryer section introduction to the context a reader needs at a glance, dropping the dish-by-dish enumeration and the timing generalization while keeping every disclaimer. The section is now presented as a lens over the single catalogue rather than as a second list of its members. Membership, order, record classes, sources, and rights are unchanged.

Added the Quick Air-Fryer section: seven original practical notes, a new record class that is neither sourced nor fixture, placed between the sourced oven set and the three fixtures. The collection gained its first editorial section, which groups those seven without changing anyone's membership. No existing record changed.

Added four further sourced beginner oven recipes — chicken thigh, salmon, halloumi and chickpea, and root vegetable — after the two already released and before the three fixtures. The three fixtures and the two earlier sourced records are unchanged in substance.
Added two sourced beginner oven recipes ahead of the three existing fixtures, which are unchanged. The collection is now mixed, and the notice and scope note say so.
Initial fixture collection created alongside the first Library framework build. No prior version exists.
